title: Crestline Companion Reinstatement Fee for Repeated Voluntary Cancellations
content:
**Terms.** On a Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes product, how the reinstatement fee is worked out follows the number of trip reinstatements on the certificate or pass whose ground is a voluntary cancellation, the one being settled included:

1. three or more such reinstatements make the fee the product's reinstatement fee multiplied by that number;
2. exactly two make the fee 25 percent of the value refunded on the cancelled booking, rounded half up to the cent;
3. a single one leaves the fee at the product's reinstatement fee, charged once.

The value refunded on the cancelled booking is the most recent taxes-and-fees refund on the ledger plus the most recent companion fare refund and the most recent Hawaii surcharge refund, each of these two counted only when it was recorded on the same entry date as that taxes-and-fees refund.

Reinstatements on the ground of a Crestline cancellation are not counted.

## Hypothetical cases (product's reinstatement fee of 50 USD)

| Voluntary-cancellation reinstatements on the product, including this one | Fee |
|---|---|
| 1 | 50.00 USD |
| 2, with 137.40 USD refunded on the cancelled booking | 25 percent of 137.40, that is 34.35 USD |
| 2, with 119.10 USD refunded | 29.775, rounded half up to 29.78 USD |
| 3 | 50 multiplied by 3, that is 150.00 USD |
| 4 | 200.00 USD |

A certificate with one earlier voluntary reinstatement and one Crestline-cancellation reinstatement, settling a new voluntary reinstatement, counts 2.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
